title: EndoVLM: An Endoscopy Vision-Language Pre-training Model via Anatomy-Guided Sparsity and Progressive Alignment
text: Presents EndoVLM, a vision-language foundation model pre-trained on 348K endoscopic examinations with anatomy-guided sparse pooling and progressive alignment, significantly outperforming existing models on risk stratification, polyp segmentation, and zero-shot generalization.
